name: Twophase
description: Two rule fields in different inks, one shifted half a period off the other, so the cell fills without either doubling up.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 22%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 11%, #000 11% 22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 11%, #000 11% 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
